note: Versioned failure signatures for CLI agent output. Same doctrine as agentLife/fidelity.json: a per-CLI row exists only once its patterns were verified against that CLI's real output, stamped with verifiedAt. The generic tier matches provider- and transport-level wording that is not any one CLI's to change. Patterns are case-insensitive substrings, never regexes — a signature that needs a regex needs a verified row instead.
